Privacy

JAQA does not store, proxy, log, persist, or analyze user searches. Searches are sent directly from the user’s browser to selected public data providers. Hosting providers and data providers may maintain their own infrastructure logs according to their own policies.

  • No accounts, cookies, local storage, browser databases, service workers, analytics or tracking pixels.
  • Workspace searches go directly from your browser to the selected public data providers. They are never sent to JAQA, never written into the URL and never stored.
  • The JAQA server only fetches fixed, allowlisted official feeds (Global Monitor) and serves the 3D globe’s data providers. It writes no access logs.
  • Clear Session wipes everything in memory. Closing the tab does the same.
  • Hosting providers and data providers may keep their own infrastructure logs under their own policies.

What not to enter

Do not enter confidential commercial, financial, insurance, claims, procurement, personal, health, bank, payment or other protected information. JAQA rejects inputs that look sensitive and never stores them.

The 3D globe

God’s Eye View runs at /globe/ and requests its layers from public providers through the JAQA server. If its voice agent is enabled on the server, your voice is sent to OpenAI to operate it. Links from the workspace to the globe carry only coordinates and a visual style, never your search terms.
